home.title: One workspace for recruitment content, publishing schedules and candidates.
home.description: RecruitOps is built around modular boundaries, official APIs and human-in-the-loop workflows when a platform does not support compliant automation.
home.foundationHint: Frontend, API and free-tier infrastructure are online. Job Hub and Candidate CRM now use authenticated server-side persistence APIs.
home.publishingDescription: Draft content, create platform variants, choose destinations and track publication state.
home.candidateDescription: Track candidate sources, CVs, recruitment stages and commissions in one workflow.
